g.text: Graph revision AD - module01: One module bay, exploded view: electrolyte reservoir (PVC-U walls, open top), four support posts, bipolar plate field between its end plates, lifting beam

Graph revision AD - module01: Bus flats 20 x 6.3 copper at the lower end plate (AQS-BUS-001 class method; POWER.md states no ZNBR2 bus section)
Graph revision AD - module01: Tie rods M16 in the end-plate ledges; pump and cooler envelopes at the bay flank (purchased, plan rule 6)
